drafted_from: tool:list-sent-emails's own row (tools/email-sending-domains/tool-rows.json: its words, input schema and sample run) and test/list-sent-emails.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Which emails did my Resend account send in the last 5 days, and was each delivered?", naming the held key, {"key_name": "resend-api-key-of-my-shop", "days": 5}. It runs tool:list-sent-emails and answers {"emails":[{"id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000041","to":["delivered@example.org"],"subject":"Hello","created_at":"2026-11-25 14:45:46.162+00","last_event":"delivered"}],"count":1,"complete":true}
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads the emails your email-sending account sent and writes nothing.
instructions: 1. Connect your Resend account once, so its key is held in your vault under a name of yours (a key with full access: a sending-only key cannot read emails). The key is never typed into the request.

2. Say to your AI: "List the emails my Resend account sent in the last <days> days" (1 to 30), and give the held key's name. It calls tools:run with tool tool:list-sent-emails and {"key_name": "<that name>", "days": <days>}.

3. Read each email's id, addressees, subject, when it was sent and last_event (sent, delivered, bounced, opened, clicked or complained). complete false means the read stopped at its page limit before the window's start. Bodies and the key are never shown.

worked_examples.title: Two emails in the last five days, one bounced
worked_examples.ask: Which emails did my Resend account send in the last 5 days?
worked_examples.given: The row's sample run: GET https://api.resend.com/emails?limit=100 answering two made-up emails. Ids and addresses are synthetic.
